source_snapshot.procedure: Cable easy to plug/unplug; device redetects without error after plug cycle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY with connector identity, service-state gate and link/device recovery.

old_problem: Cable/endpoints, vendor latch procedure, service power state, cycle count and port-specific link oracle were absent; subjective `easy` could encourage force or unsafe hot removal.
disposition_reason: The source does not require hot-plug coverage. Under ED-09 the qualified operator can use the conservative vendor-approved powered-down/discharged service path; IDs, procedure and expected link values are runtime prerequisites under ED-03. This preserves plug-cycle/seating/redetection without inventing hot-removal support.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2268 and 2269, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve CX7 cable removal/reinsertion, objective proper seating and post-cycle device detection without errors.
Default Review-layer safety boundary is full vendor-approved powered-down/quiesced/discharged service; hot removal is forbidden unless separately documented and authorized.
Bind adapter/port, cable PN/serial and both endpoints; inspect latch, pins, shell, routing and bend radius before/after one cycle.
After restore/boot/settle, compare exact PCIe/HCA/network identity, negotiated width/rate/state, counters and logs to baseline; redundancy cannot mask the target path.
No workload drain, power action, cable handling, boot or DUT query occurred.

test_case.test_name: Powered-down CX7 cable remove/reseat and port recovery
test_case.purpose: Verify one mapped CX7 cable/connector pair can be safely removed and fully re-seated without damage and that its exact port returns with baseline device/link/error health.
required_package: Objective seating/damage/routing criteria, one-cycle count and settle timeout
Expected PCIe/HCA/network identity, link width/rate/state and error limits
test_case.test_command: Quiesce traffic, record baseline, power down/discharge per vendor procedure, then a qualified operator photographs/inspects and performs one latch-controlled remove/reinsert cycle without force; restore power, wait readiness/settle and collect exact target PCIe/HCA/network/link/counter/log evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The correct cable is fully latched/seated with no pin/shell/routing/bend damage, the mapped CX7 device/port redetects exactly, negotiated link returns to the approved width/rate/state, counters/logs stay within limits and final health is normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires real physical before/after evidence plus target-specific digital recovery. Runtime IDs/spec values must be bound before execution. Excessive force, damage, incomplete latch, missing/degraded/wrong link or new disallowed errors is FAIL.
safety_gate: Qualified operator, ESD controls and vendor powered-down/discharged procedure.
No hot removal unless separately proven and authorized.
One cycle only; stop on resistance, misalignment or damage.
No retry to force link recovery; preserve logs.
test_case.recovery: On damage, resistance or failed recovery, keep the system safe/off as applicable, preserve physical/digital evidence and use the approved spare/rollback procedure; do not repeat insertion or hot-service the connector.

source_conflict.reason: Source consistently requires plug-cycle, seating and error-free redetection.

blocked.reason: A conservative powered-down service procedure removes the unrequired hot-plug ambiguity.
